checks.name: aigas_ld_events_check
checks.definition:
CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(metadata_json) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((metadata_json)::text) <= 1024) AND (jsonb_typeof((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND ((NOT (metadata_json ? 'evidence_policy_version'::text)) OR ((metadata_json ->> 'evidence_policy_version'::text) ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,120}$'::text)) AND
CASE source
    WHEN 'ledger.synthetic-lab'::text THEN ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['synthetic.test.created'::text, 'synthetic.review.recorded'::text])) AND (metadata_json ?& ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'scenario'::text, 'outcome'::text, 'decision_ref'::text]) AND ((metadata_json - ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'scenario'::text, 'outcome'::text, 'decision_ref'::text, 'evidence_policy_version'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'scenario'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['integrity-check'::text, 'access-check'::text])) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'outcome'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['RECORDED'::text, 'REVIEWED'::text])))
    WHEN 'firewall'::text THEN ((event_type = 'firewall.decision.recorded'::text) AND (metadata_json ?& ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'decision_ref'::text, 'action'::text, 'mode'::text, 'rule_ref'::text, 'rule_version'::text]) AND ((metadata_json - ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'decision_ref'::text, 'action'::text, 'mode'::text, 'rule_ref'::text, 'rule_version'::text, 'evidence_policy_version'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'action'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['ALLOW'::text, 'BLOCK'::text, 'REDACT'::text])) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'mode'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['LAB'::text, 'GUARD'::text])))
    WHEN 'human-gate'::text THEN ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['human_gate.request.created'::text, 'human_gate.decision.recorded'::text, 'human_gate.demo_note.completed'::text])) AND (metadata_json ?& ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'request_ref'::text, 'operation_scope'::text]) AND ((metadata_json - ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'request_ref'::text, 'decision_ref'::text, 'decision'::text, 'operation_scope'::text, 'evidence_policy_version'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'operation_scope'::text) = 'INTERNAL_DEMO_NOTE'::text) AND ((event_type <> 'human_gate.decision.recorded'::text) OR ((metadata_json ?& ARRAY['decision_ref'::text, 'decision'::text]) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'decision'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVE'::text, 'REJECT'::text])))))
    WHEN 'risk-engine'::text THEN ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['risk_engine.asset.created'::text, 'risk_engine.asset.updated'::text, 'risk_engine.assessment.created'::text])) AND (metadata_json ?& ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'asset_ref'::text, 'asset_version'::text]) AND ((metadata_json - ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'asset_ref'::text, 'asset_version'::text, 'assessment_ref'::text, 'risk_level'::text, 'evidence_policy_version'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text) = 'false'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'asset_version'::text) ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'::text) AND ((event_type <> 'risk_engine.assessment.created'::text) OR ((metadata_json ?& ARRAY['assessment_ref'::text, 'risk_level'::text]) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'risk_level'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['LOW'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text, 'HIGH'::text])))))
    WHEN 'kernel'::text THEN ((event_type = 'kernel.audit.recorded'::text) AND (metadata_json ?& ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'audit_ref'::text, 'action'::text]) AND ((metadata_json - ARRAY['synthetic'::text, 'audit_ref'::text, 'action'::text, 'evidence_policy_version'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((metadata_json -> 'synthetic'::text) = 'false'::jsonb) AND (char_length((metadata_json ->> 'action'::text)) <= 100) AND ((metadata_json ->> 'action'::text) ~ '^(workspace[.]created|kernel[.][a-z_.-]+)$'::text))
    ELSE false
END) IS TRUE))
